items.title: Musubi 0.2.19: Edit iCloud event details
items.body:
Musubi can now save a new title, description or location for some of your own timed, non-recurring iCloud events, once the server operator turns this on. It is off by default. All-day and recurring events, events with guests, and changes to time or calendar are among the cases not covered.

This server and web update works with existing mobile apps. See the release notes for the exact scope.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.19

items.title: Musubi 0.2.18: Fewer blocked event edits
items.body:
Improved recovery when editing or deleting your own event conflicts only because Outlook, iCloud or Google updated its own details on the synced copy. The first attempt may still report a conflict and save nothing; a later attempt can then succeed. Some events, copies and server setups are not covered; see the release notes for the limits.

This server and web update works with existing mobile apps.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.18

items.title: Musubi 0.2.17: Multi-day events and busy sync
items.body:
Timed events that span several days now appear on every day in Month view, and their details show the real end date. Background sync of other connected accounts now leaves room for your event changes, and a write that cannot start in time says that nothing was saved. This is not a complete fix for slow sync.

This server and web update works with existing mobile apps.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.17

items.title: Musubi 0.2.16: Event creation during sync
items.body:
Improved event creation while connected calendars are syncing in the background.

This server and web update works with existing mobile apps.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.16

items.title: Musubi 0.2.15: Google connection fixes
items.body:
Fixed Google token refresh interrupting calendar writes and sync when unchanged permissions are returned in a different order. Added safer diagnostics for unexpected event permission-check failures.

This API and web update works with existing mobile apps.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.15

items.title: Musubi 0.2.14: iCloud import fixes
items.body:
Fixed initial iCloud imports for accounts with many calendars and large CalDAV calendars. Event notes containing HTML text now import correctly, and pending sync is shown separately from failures.

This API and web maintenance update works with existing mobile apps.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.14

items.title: Musubi 0.2.13: More reliable sync
items.body:
Improved calendar and task synchronization, with clearer diagnostics. Expected waits during account sync are now reported separately from failures.

This API and web maintenance update works with the 0.2.12 mobile apps.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.13

items.title: Musubi 0.2.12: Sync, widgets and shared news
items.body:
Calendar and task sync improvements, updated Android widgets, and layout fixes. The web app opens without the oversized logo flash, and project news is now shared across Musubi servers.

Includes web and server security updates.

https://github.com/f-tuma/musubi/releases/tag/v0.2.12
